task_completion_reasoning: The assistant correctly provided order status and full details including the shipping address, and the user explicitly confirmed that they had all they needed.

criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user asks again, "can you remind me of the shipping address on that order again?", the bot responds with the shipping address: "Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich".

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the conversation does the bot claim it has lost access to prior data or tools; it continues to answer about the same order normally each time.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For the follow-up questions about the order’s shipping address, the bot only provides that address and does not re-list all order details or multiple orders.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: After the initial identification of the Galaxy Watch order, the bot never asks again which order the user means and answers follow-ups directly using the existing context.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: All user questions about the order and shipping address were answered fully, accurately, and specifically each time.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no instances of user pushback or disfluency for the assistant to repair, and all follow-up questions were handled smoothly.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referred to the correct order and repeated the same shipping address without contradiction or unnecessary re-asking.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was clear, polite, and easy to read, though the repeated abrupt 'Goodbye' responses were slightly formulaic.
